comment: Fixed-ratio, two-asset basket per PLAN.md §0. Ratios live in the StratusBasketToken deploy script (contracts/script/01-deploy-basket-token.ts), not here — this file only describes ATS issuance parameters. isinPrefix11 is the 2-letter country code + 9 alphanumeric chars; the checksum digit is computed at runtime by tokenization/scripts/lib/isin.ts (real ISINs require a valid ISO 6166 checksum — see docs/phase-0-findings.md Finding 3).
